item.title: Trump Administration Divide on China Policy Breaks Into Public View
item.description: The airing of a fight over advanced A.I. chips shows how much the Nvidia scandal has deepened fissures inside the government, just as President Trump heads to a critical meeting with his Chinese counterpart.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Swan, Maggie Haberman, Ana Swanson and Shawn McCreesh
item.category: Ministry of State Security of the People's Republic of China
Far East, South and Southeast Asia and Pacific Areas
item.media:description: President Trump acknowledged on Monday that the Treasury and commerce secretaries had been at odds over how hard to crack down on a loophole that has allowed China to access advanced A.I. chips through data centers in other countries.

item.title: Madison Huang, Jensen Huang’s Daughter, Became a Powerful Force at Nvidia
item.description: Installed as her father’s de facto chief of staff, Jensen Huang’s daughter alienated top executives. Now her lingering role poses a test for interim C.E.O. Colette Kress.
item.dc:creator: Kalley Huang, Tripp Mickle and Ryan Mac
item.media:description: Madison Huang, a senior director of product marketing at Nvidia and daughter of Jensen Huang, at the 2026 World Robot Conference, in Beijing in August.

item.title: Bessent Takes Hawkish Turn in White House Debate on China
item.description: The Treasury secretary who sought to de-escalate tariff wars is taking a tougher approach to exports of sensitive U.S. technology.
item.dc:creator: Alan Rappeport and Ana Swanson
item.media:credit: Haiyun Jiang for The New York Times
item.media:description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, left, and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick have a long-running rivalry that recently spilled into the open over Nvidia.

item.title: United Airlines Flights Resume After ‘Widespread System Outage’
item.description: The brief disruption, after a nationwide ground stop last week, added to concerns about air travel ahead of a busy Thanksgiving travel period.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Sinco Kelleher, Niraj Chokshi and Ryley Ober
item.media:description: United Airlines said that “while some flights were delayed” by a “widespread system outage,” there was “no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights,” referring to its regional network of smaller carriers.

item.title: Chase Bank Resumes Normal Operations After ‘Software Bug’ Disrupted Transactions
item.description: After technical problems grounded flights nationwide and Microsoft products failed, the banking issues added to a sense of doom about the systems underpinning daily life.
item.dc:creator: Michael Levenson
item.media:credit: An Rong Xu for The New York Times
item.media:description: J.P. Morgan Chase said in a statement it was dealing with a technical issue that was affecting its banking customers.

item.title: Pilots Kept Contact With Controllers During Nationwide Halt to Flights
item.description: Pilots were generally able to maintain contact with air traffic controllers and airline staff on the ground despite an outage that caused a nearly five-hour halt to departures.
item.dc:creator: Niraj Chokshi
item.media:description: A plane lands at O’Hare International Airport in Chicago on Friday during the stoppage of flights across the country.

item.title: Tucked in a Closet, Hidden by a Coat, a Lost Work by Georgia O’Keeffe
